verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with gc-decomp-harness, this board has cleaner modular sectioning and more generous local air, but lacks the reference’s compact frame use, deliberate density variation, and consistently economical inter-region routing.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The eight regions form a balanced grid, but the large unused band beneath the bottom row leaves the overall frame visibly underfilled.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Nodes and label chips have ample breathing room, with wide gaps between sequential stages and no visibly cramped text.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Eight numbered, lightly tinted regions provide explicit and effective functional grouping, generally holding only a few nodes apiece.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Distinct section and flow-family hues are restrained and consistent, although gray links and exception colors do not establish semantics as rigorously as the gc reference.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junctions or orphaned badges are visible, but the purple return path makes an awkward exposed loop around the durable-log nodes.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Section columns, headers, and principal node rows hold strong registers, though the sparse lower-right region and oversized outer margins weaken density rhythm.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Most local links are short and clean, but the long purple out-of-order route and the pink every-trace connector create conspicuous inter-row detours.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The assigned scores and visual ordering agree: gc-decomp-harness and the board under grade are jointly strongest at 7.5, with intent-classification-2 slightly behind at 7.0 because of its larger compositional imbalance.
